summary: A "Learn more" style link that points to a Mozilla support (SUMO) page.
description:
A customized built-in <a is="moz-support-link"> for linking to Mozilla's SUMO support documentation. Its class extends StylesMixin(HTMLAnchorElement, styles), so it is a subclass of HTMLAnchorElement that also adopts moz-support-link.css onto its root.

**It builds its own href** from a support-page short-hand plus the app's support base URL (the app.support.baseURL pref), optionally appending AMO-only UTM parameters via utm-content, and always opens in a new tab/window via openTrustedLinkIn.

**It fills its own localized text** via Fluent when no content or data-l10n-id is supplied.

attributes.name: support-page
attributes.description: Short-hand string identifying the specific SUMO support page; combined with the app's support base URL to build href. Also exposed as the supportPage JS property.

attributes.name: utm-content
attributes.description: UTM content parameter appended to the URL, only applied when the resulting URL is an AMO (mozilla.org/allizom.org) URL.

attributes.name: data-l10n-id
attributes.description: Fluent id used to generate the link's text content when none is otherwise provided.
